Hello,

Usage-based charges accrued beyond the plan allowance can make the invoice higher than expected. A resource left running in a non-production environment is billed at the same rate as production and can increase the invoice. The billing period runs from the anniversary of the subscription date, not necessarily the first of the month. Open the usage breakdown for the period to see charges itemised by service and environment.

If this does not solve the problem, reply to this message and a member of our support team will help you.
